lines.speaker: Sasuke
lines.text: Tch... huff... to think your strikes could pierce through my guard...

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: You're formidable, Sasuke. But my journey doesn't end here.

lines.speaker: Sasuke
lines.text: Hmph. Fine. You've proven you have the strength to back up your words.

lines.speaker: Sasuke
lines.text: The path beyond leads straight to the final convergence. Don't let your guard down.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: I'm ready for whatever awaits at the end of the line.

lines.speaker: Sasuke
lines.text: Keep moving forward. Make sure you don't fall before reaching your destiny.
